question: Where can I get a list of mobile network antenna sites in the United States, with location, operator and technology?

answer.summary: No official national list of mobile antenna sites with operator and technology was found. The FCC publishes two partial files: ULS Cellular-service licenses (24,366 transmitter locations with licensee, coordinates and ASR link; market-based bands list almost no sites) and the Antenna Structure Registration (142,039 standing registered structures with owner, usually a tower company, but no tenants or technology). States and cities fill gaps locally, e.g. Connecticut's Siting Council (carrier, structure owner, 5G flag; no coordinates) and city small-cell datasets.
main_caveats: ASR registers structures needing FAA notice (over 200 ft or near airports): no antennas, tenants or technology; owner is usually a tower company.
ULS site locations exist only for Cellular (CL) licenses; PCS/AWS/700 MHz market licenses are area-based and list almost no sites.
Shared sites appear once per license/call sign (ULS) or per Council action (Connecticut); deduplicate by coordinates or address.
Licensee and carrier names are historical legal entities (Cellco Partnership, New Cingular, Sprint), not current brands.
fcc.gov pages and tower company site locators (American Tower, SBA) block automated clients; data.fcc.gov bulk downloads work.
answer.confidence_reason: FCC ASR and ULS files downloaded and joined; state and city sources tested. FCC documentation was blocked (403) so field codes were inferred from data and the HIFLD schema.

attributes.note: Exact coordinates per CL transmitter location (ULS) and per registered structure (ASR); small cells only in some city datasets.
attributes.gap_note: Market-based licenses in l_market.zip have almost no LO rows (CW 1,141 rows for 7,012 licenses; AW 5 for 3,633); ASR excludes structures not needing FAA notice.

attributes.note: Licensee per CL location (ULS); carrier per siting action (Connecticut); applicant per pole (Boston).
attributes.gap_note: ASR names structure owners, not tenant operators; no national list of operators per shared site found.

attributes.note: ULS gives radio service/band (CL); Connecticut flags 5G on 1,035 rows; OSM has lte/5g tags on 5 CT elements.
attributes.gap_note: No national per-site LTE/5G field found in FCC files; OpenCelliD (per-cell data) requires a token and was not tested.

sources.name: FCC Universal Licensing System complete license file, Cellular radio service (l_cell.zip: HD, EN, LO records)
sources.publisher: Federal Communications Commission (FCC), Wireless Telecommunications Bureau
sources.summary: Official FCC file of Cellular-service transmitter locations with licensee, coordinates, address, structure type and ASR link.
sources.coverage_note: 24,366 locations of 3,871 active CL licenses (22,354 distinct coordinates); file of 2026-11-22.
caveats: CL licenses only; market-based bands list almost no sites.

problems: fcc.gov documentation pages (ULS data definitions, code tables) return HTTP 403 to automated clients; data.fcc.gov downloads work.

example.example_request: curl -O 'https://data.fcc.gov/download/pub/uls/complete/l_cell.zip'  # 25,268,720 bytes; unzip and join HD, EN and LO on the unique system identifier (2nd field)
example.example_result: LO|193547|||WPOI466||F|T|1|||400 Bering Street|NOME|NOME|AK||||10.3|64|30|2.6|N|165|24|37.0|W|||||||||N||1058710|15.8|19.2|LTOWER; EN licensee (type L): AT&T Mobility Spectrum, LLC

sources.name: FCC Antenna Structure Registration complete file (r_tower.zip: RA, CO, EN records)
sources.summary: National FCC registry of tall or airport-near antenna structures with coordinates, type, height, status dates and structure owner.
sources.coverage_note: 198,135 registrations; 142,039 constructed and not dismantled (status C) in the 2026-11-22 file.
caveats: Structures, not antennas: no tenant operators or technology.

problems: FCC ASR web pages and search (wireless2.fcc.gov) return HTTP 403 to automated clients.

sources.name: Wireless Telecommunication Tower Sites Under Siting Council Jurisdiction (data.ct.gov gv8b-8pce)
sources.summary: Connecticut state record of tower siting actions with carrier, structure owner, tower type and a 5G flag per facility.
sources.coverage_note: 12,443 action rows, about 1,172 distinct addresses; current as of 2025-01-03; Connecticut only.
caveats: Rows are Council actions, not sites.

sources.name: City small-cell / wireless facility datasets (open data portals)
sources.license: Open Data Commons PDDL (Boston); others Unknown
sources.summary: Some cities publish small-cell/DAS points; Boston adds the applicant carrier or neutral host per pole.
sources.coverage_note: Boston 1,372 approvals since 2017; Los Angeles 3,013 small cells without operator.

members_summary.scope_note: Hundreds of cities permit small cells; no national list of city datasets. 3 probed, 2 with data.
members_summary.pattern: City open data portals: 'small cell', 'wireless antenna', 'wireless facility permits', 'DAS'.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap communication towers and masts (Overpass API)
sources.summary: Community-mapped towers/masts with a mobile phone flag; operator/technology rarely tagged.
sources.coverage_note: Connecticut bbox: 918 elements, 631 flagged mobile, 41 with operator.

if_unstructured.summary: Per-site tenants and technology appear mainly in state and local siting records (dockets, petitions, permits); Connecticut publishes them as a dataset. Other states' dockets and FAA OE/AAA filings were not tested, so no manual recipe is given.

local_terms.meaning: FCC Universal Licensing System weekly bulk downloads on data.fcc.gov.
FCC Antenna Structure Registration weekly bulk file.
FCC registry of structures requiring FAA notification (47 CFR 17.4).
ULS location record with coordinates and ASR number.
Low-power nodes on poles; tracked in city permit datasets, not ASR.
Infrastructure provider hosting several carriers (Boston field value).
FCC site-based mobile license service code with location records.
Connecticut state body that approves tower sites and tower sharing.
